title: Structural basis of SIRT7 nucleosome engagement and substrate specificity
authors: Moreno-Yruela C; Ekundayo BE; Foteva PN; Calvino-Sanles E; Ni D; Stahlberg H; Fierz B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜解析SIRT7与核小体的复合物结构，研究组蛋白去酰化酶对核小体底物的识别机制，属于蛋白质-DNA（核小体）互作的结构研究，但对象为酶-核小体而非典型TF-DNA体系，且方法以结构生物学为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，故评分为5。
abstract: Chromatin-modifying enzymes selectively target distinct residues within histones to finetune gene expression profiles. SIRT7 is an NAD + -dependent histone deacylase often deregulated in cancer, which deacetylates either H3 lysine 36 (H3K36) or H3K18 with high specificity within nucleosomes. Here, we report structures of nucleosome-bound SIRT7, and uncover the structural basis of its specificity towards H3K36 and K18 deacylation, combining a mechanism-based cross-linking strategy, cryo-EM, mutagenesis and enzymatic assays. We show that the SIRT7 N-terminus represents a unique, extended nucleosome-binding domain, reaching across the nucleosomal surface to the acidic patch. The catalytic domain binds at the H3-tail exit site, engaging both DNA gyres of the nucleosome. Contacting H3K36 versus H3K18 requires a change in enzyme binding pose, and results in structural changes in both SIRT7 and the nucleosome. These structures reveal interactions critical for target lysine specificity, allowing us to engineer enzyme activity towards H3K18 or 36, and provides a basis for small molecule modulator development.
abstract_zh: 染色质修饰酶选择性地靶向组蛋白内的不同残基，以微调基因表达谱。SIRT7是一种NAD+依赖的组蛋白去酰化酶，常在癌症中失调，它在核小体内以高特异性去乙酰化H3赖氨酸36（H3K36）或H3K18。在此，我们报告了核小体结合的SIRT7的结构，并结合基于机制的交叉连接策略、冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）、诱变和酶学测定，揭示了其对H3K36和K18去酰化特异性的结构基础。我们表明，SIRT7的N端代表一个独特的、延伸的核小体结合结构域，跨越核小体表面到达酸性斑块。催化结构域结合在H3尾部出口位点，同时接触核小体的两条DNA回旋。接触H3K36与H3K18需要酶结合姿态的改变，并导致SIRT7和核小体两者的结构变化。这些结构揭示了对靶标赖氨酸特异性至关重要的相互作用，使我们能够设计针对H3K18或36的酶活性，并为小分子调节剂的开发提供了基础。
